edges.reason: transfer() uses msg.sender as the implicit source address.
transferFrom() reads allowance[_from][msg.sender] to authorize third-party spending.
approve() stores the allowance under msg.sender as owner.
delegate() authorizes only with require(msg.sender == owner).
_mints() authorizes by comparing msg.sender with owner or a hardcoded address.
init() is gated solely by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() is gated solely by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() is gated solely by require(msg.sender == owner).
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to it.
msg.sender comparison to owner is the only barrier protecting the arbitrary delegatecall.
Mint authorization depends on msg.sender matching owner or a hardcoded 1e39-like address.
transfer() delegates all logic to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom() calls require(ensure(_from, _to, _value)) before mutating balances.
ensure() calls condition(_from, _value) when the address is not whitelisted.
ensure() computes the router pair address through pairFor().
delegate() executes a.delegatecall(b), granting arbitrary code execution to the caller-supplied target.
callOptionalReturn relies on an unchecked external low-level call to the token, which can call back into the caller.
The unchecked balanceOf/allowance mutations of transferFrom flow into the unchecked arithmetic operation.
batchSend's total computation and balance updates feed the unchecked arithmetic operation.
_mints() overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue*(10**decimals) without SafeMath or addition.
_mints() sets canSale[spender] = true, permanently whitelisting an arbitrary address.
init() sets _minSale from the token argument.
init() sets _maxSale from the maxToken argument.
init() sets _saleNum from the saleNum argument.
setTradeAddress() writes the address that is exempt from the sale gate.
transferFrom() does balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value with no overflow checks.
transferFrom() decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] unchecked and is skipped entirely when _value == 0.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from], the counter used to ration sales.
batchSend() subtracts total from balanceOf[msg.sender] and adds _value per recipient unchecked.
condition() reads _saleNum to decide whether sale limits are active.
condition() compares _value against _minSale.
condition() compares _value against _maxSale.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sale count.
ensure() grants an unconditional whitelist bypass when canSale[_from] is true.
ensure() exempts tradeAddress from the sale gate.
ensure() exempts owner from the sale gate.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
Constructor sets totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals).
Constructor credits the full supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor sets allowance[msg.sender][router] = uint(-1), an unlimited approval.
_mints() scales addedValue by 10**decimals.
init() scales token/maxToken by 10**decimals.
_to parameter is forwarded by transfer().
_value parameter is forwarded by transfer().
_from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom().
_to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom().
_value parameter drives all arithmetic in transferFrom().
The caller-controlled _value is the operand of the unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic.
_from parameter selects the whitelist branch in ensure().
_to parameter is compared against owner in ensure().
_value is passed through ensure() to condition().
_from indexes _onSaleNum in condition().
_value is range-checked against _minSale/_maxSale in condition().
Delegatecall target is a caller-supplied parameter.
Arbitrary calldata payload supplied to delegatecall.
Untrusted target address a reaches the delegatecall operation.
Untrusted bytes b are executed verbatim by delegatecall.
spender receives the minted balance and the canSale flag.
addedValue is multiplied by 10**decimals and assigned unchecked.
saleNum configures the per-address sale limit.
token configures _minSale.
maxToken configures _maxSale.
_tos supplies the recipient list iterated by batchSend().
_value is multiplied by the array length to compute the debit.
_value * _tos.length can overflow and is not validated.
addr becomes the sale-gate-exempt tradeAddress.
_spender is the allowance key in approve().
_value is stored verbatim as the allowance in approve().
Locally computed pair address is compared against _from in ensure().
total = _value * _tos.length is computed with unchecked multiplication.
Loop index i bounds the recipient iteration in batchSend().
Local _to receives _value on each loop iteration.
Code executed through delegatecall runs in MrMr's context and can re-enter transferFrom()/transfer().
